guidelines: No generic sans (Inter/Roboto) for headings. Use Work Sans to inject character.
Tight letter spacing on headings (>32px).
Loose leading for body text to improve readability in dense ticket descriptions.
Use stark white or 10% grey for backgrounds. Color is function only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome.
Green=Good/SLA OK, Yellow=Warning, Red=Violation/Critical must pop prominently against the neutral background.
Use purely semantic colors for badges and alerts to guide immediate action.

surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): Expose the skeleton for data-heavy sections. border-r border-b border-border/40 on grid items.
Flat Solid: For dashboard widgets and ticket cards, use flat backgrounds with a 1px subtle border, no heavy shadow.
Neumorphism (Tactile): For small action buttons and toggles, use subtle inner shadows with sharp 1px borders.
guidelines: Avoid glassmorphism on operational data tables to maintain clarity.
Hover states on cards: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), subtle shadow (shadow-lg), border color darkens.

patterns.dashboard_summary: Top row KPI cards (Open incidents, open requests, SLA attainment).
patterns.main_queue: Live table for operational queue below KPIs, spanning full width.
patterns.trends: Trend widgets in the middle (ticket volume, resolution trend) spanning 2 columns.

guidelines: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children to ensure they stretch. No jagged bottoms.
Mobile-first responsive grids. Ensure optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Micro-animations for hover, click, and focus states on all interactive elements.
Smooth staggered entrance animations for ticket list rows.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for accessibility.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all), target specific properties (e.g., transition-colors).

libraries: Shadcn UI (Tables, Dropdowns, Dialogs, Cards, Tabs, Select)
Recharts or Shadcn Charts (for KPI and Trend visuals)
Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for dense dashboard layouts.
guidelines: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
Customize Shadcn radii (max 8px) and spacing to match the technical aesthetic.
DO NOT use raw HTML elements for complex interactive elements (e.g., <select>, <input type='date'>). Use Shadcn.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text, 3:1 for large text.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='ticket-resolve-btn').
Do not use complete transparent background in headers/dropdowns to ensure readability.

image_urls.description: Technician / Support Staff avatar (man with headset)
Customer / Manager avatar (man in coffee shop)
Login page background image showing support staff working

architecture_and_flow: Build a dashboard-first application emphasizing ITSM features: Customer/User -> Ticket -> Assignment -> Resolution -> Rating -> KPI.
Implement Email/Username authentication on the Login Page with demo data pre-configured.
Implement empty Telegram and WhatsApp configuration fields in Settings (placeholder UI).
Ensure an attachment upload option directly in the ticket form and detail view, include UI states for compression process.
Ensure UI actions for Exporting to CSV and PDF are prominently placed on Reports and Ticket views.
functional_requirements: Dashboard: Include Top-level KPI cards, SLA compliance widget, Ticket per month/category/priority charts, and Top performing tech list.
Ticket Management: Include robust filter/search/pagination, detailed view with activity timeline, priority badge, and explicit SLA color indicators (Green/Yellow/Red).
SLA Configuration: Build rules per priority in settings.
KPI Management: Build configurable weights (SLA 25%, Completion 20%, Response 15%, Resolution 15%, Reopen 10%, Rating 10%, Docs 5%).
Role-Based Access: Prepare UI structures to accommodate Admin, Manager, Supervisor, Technician, and Customer views.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Do not center-align the app container. Respect natural reading flow.
Layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and subtle grain textures/noise overlays.
Do not use generic simplistic gradients; use flat colors with stark borders for this app.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons; rely strictly on the chosen icon library (@phosphor-icons/react).
All interactive elements MUST have micro-animations and explicit hover/focus states.
Ensure 'data-testid' is attached to all meaningful components.
Provide installation commands for external libraries in standard bash steps if needed.
